mcp_server/codebase-memory-mcp.tagline: Index your code and answer questions fast
mcp_server/codebase-memory-mcp.overview: DeusData Codebase Memory MCP indexes your codebase and answers questions about it quickly. It gives AI coding agents fast lookups across your project's code, so they can find relevant files and details without re-reading everything. This makes working in larger projects smoother.
capabilities: Answer questions about your project quickly
Give AI agents fast code lookups
useCases: Students working in an unfamiliar codebase who need quick orientation
Developers letting an AI agent search a large project efficiently
howTo: Clone the repo from github.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp
Follow the README to install and build the server
Register it with your MCP-compatible coding agent
Point it at your project so it can index the code

mcp_server/bright-data.tagline: Scrape tough sites into structured data
mcp_server/bright-data.overview: Bright Data MCP scrapes websites and returns structured data through Bright Data's web infrastructure. It is built to handle sites that block ordinary scrapers, so you can collect data that simple requests can't reach. It is useful for research and data gathering at scale.
capabilities: Handle sites that block ordinary scrapers
useCases: Students gathering data for a research project
Anyone needing data from sites that block basic scrapers
howTo: Run npx -y @brightdata/mcp to start the server
Provide your Bright Data credentials
Register the server with your MCP client
Ask it to scrape a site and return structured data
goodToKnow: Requires a Bright Data account and likely paid usage.
Respect each site's terms of service and applicable scraping laws.

mcp_server/akshare-chinese-stock-market.tagline: Get Chinese stock-market data via AKShare
mcp_server/akshare-chinese-stock-market.overview: This server pulls real-time and historical Chinese stock-market data using AKShare. It can return prices, news, and financial figures, so you can analyze the market by asking. It is aimed at people studying or tracking Chinese stocks.
useCases: Finance students researching Chinese equities
Anyone tracking Chinese stock prices and news from chat
howTo: Run npx -y akshare-one-mcp to start the server
Register it with your MCP client
Ask for a stock's prices, news, or financial figures
Review the returned data
goodToKnow: Focused on Chinese stock-market data via AKShare.
Data is for information only and is not financial advice.

mcp_server/perplexity-mcp.tagline: Web searches with citations via Perplexity
mcp_server/perplexity-mcp.overview: Perplexity MCP runs Perplexity web searches that return current information with citations, using the official Perplexity API. You ask a question and get up-to-date answers backed by sources. It is useful for research where you want to check where the information came from.
useCases: Students researching current topics and needing sources
Anyone wanting cited, up-to-date answers inside their assistant

Set up the server from github.com/perplexityai/modelcontextprotocol
Register it with your MCP client and add your API key
Ask research questions and review the cited results

example.code: Search the web for the latest developments in MCP servers and include citations

This is the official Perplexity server.

mcp_server/github.tagline: Work with GitHub repos, issues, and PRs
mcp_server/github.overview: The GitHub MCP server lets Claude work with your GitHub repositories, issues, and pull requests. You can browse code, search a repo, read and create issues, and review or comment on pull requests through conversation. It connects using a GitHub access token scoped to what you allow.
capabilities: Reads, creates, and comments on issues
Looks up repository details and history
Connects via a scoped GitHub access token
useCases: Triaging issues or summarizing a repo without leaving chat
Reviewing a pull request with AI help
Searching code across a project conversationally
howTo: Create a GitHub personal access token with the scopes you need
Add the GitHub MCP server to your Claude client config
Provide the token as the configured credential
Restart your client to load the connector
Ask Claude to read an issue, search code, or review a PR

example.label: Ask Claude about a repo
example.snippet: Summarize the open issues labeled 'bug' in my-org/my-repo.

goodToKnow: Scope the token to least privilege; write access lets the assistant change issues and PRs.
Available actions depend on the token's permissions and repo access.

mcp_server/documcp-rag-documentation-ser.tagline: On-premise semantic search over your docs
mcp_server/documcp-rag-documentation-ser.overview: DocuMCP runs on-premise semantic search over your code, docs, and diagrams. It connects to vector databases for retrieval, so you can ask questions and get back relevant material. Running on-premise keeps your content under your own control.
capabilities: Connect to vector databases for retrieval
useCases: Students searching their own documentation and code semantically
Teams wanting private retrieval over internal docs
howTo: Run npx -y @myjungle/docu-mcp-server to start the server
Connect it to your vector database
Register the server with your MCP client
Ask questions to retrieve relevant code, docs, or diagrams
goodToKnow: Needs a vector database to store and retrieve embeddings.
Designed to run on-premise, so you manage the infrastructure.

mcp_server/beads.tagline: Persistent issue memory for coding agents
mcp_server/beads.overview: Beads is a lightweight issue-tracking memory layer that gives a coding agent persistent context across a project. Instead of losing track of work between sessions, the agent records and reads issues like a graph of tasks, so it stays oriented and works more reliably over time. It runs as an MCP server alongside your agent.
capabilities: Stores work as persistent, linked issues
Lets the agent recall context across sessions
Tracks dependencies between pieces of work
Keeps the agent oriented on long-running projects
Runs locally as an MCP server
useCases: Long-running coding projects where context keeps getting lost
Helping an agent remember outstanding work between sessions
Tracking dependent tasks an agent is working through
howTo: Install the `bd` CLI: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gastownhall/beads/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`
Run `bd init` once inside your project to set up the issue store
Point your MCP client (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) at the beads MCP server
Let the agent create and read issues as it works
Resume a later session and have it recall prior context
goodToKnow: It is a memory and tracking aid; the agent still has to choose to use it well.
Best value shows up on multi-session projects, less so for quick one-offs.

mcp_server/mcp-server-chart.tagline: Turn data into 25+ chart types with AntV
mcp_server/mcp-server-chart.overview: MCP Server Chart generates more than 25 chart types from your data using AntV. It is built for visualizing datasets, so you can turn numbers into clear charts by asking. It is useful for reports, analysis, and presentations.
useCases: Students turning project data into charts for a report
Anyone visualizing a dataset quickly from chat
howTo: Run npx -y @antv/mcp-server-chart to start the server
Register it with your MCP client
Provide your data and the chart type you want
Review the generated chart
goodToKnow: Supports a wide range of chart types, so pick the one that fits your data.
Built on AntV's charting library.

mcp_server/clerk.tagline: Manage Clerk users, sessions, and orgs
mcp_server/clerk.overview: Clerk MCP manages Clerk authentication, including users, sessions, organizations, and access permissions. It lets you handle your app's auth setup through your assistant. It suits developers building apps that use Clerk for sign-in and user management.
useCases: Students building an app with Clerk authentication
Developers managing users and permissions from chat
howTo: Run npx -y @clerk/agent-toolkit to start the server
Provide your Clerk API keys
Register the server with your MCP client
Ask it to manage users, sessions, or organizations
goodToKnow: Requires Clerk API keys for your project.
Changes affect your app's real users and permissions, so act carefully.

mcp_server/flight-search.tagline: Search flights with flexible-date price comparison
mcp_server/flight-search.overview: This server searches flights in real time and supports flexible-date price comparison so you can find cheaper days to travel. It also offers direct booking, letting you go from search to booking in one place.
useCases: Students planning trips who want to find the cheapest dates to fly
Anyone comparing flight prices and booking through their AI assistant

Connect the MCP server to your AI client per the site's instructions
Tell your assistant your route and rough dates
Compare prices and book the flight you want

goodToKnow: Prices and availability change in real time, so confirm details before booking.
More information is available at flights.fctolabs.com.

mcp_server/yggtorrent.tagline: Search YggTorrent with filters and magnet links
mcp_server/yggtorrent.overview: This server searches YggTorrent through an unofficial API. It supports category filters, returns metadata, and can generate magnet links for the results you find.
capabilities: Searches YggTorrent via an unofficial API
useCases: Users who want to search YggTorrent from their AI assistant
Anyone filtering torrent results by category and grabbing magnet links

Register the server with your AI client
Ask your assistant to search YggTorrent with a category filter
Use the returned metadata and magnet links
goodToKnow: It uses an unofficial API, so it may break if the site changes.
Only download content you have the legal right to access.

mcp_server/deep-research-mcp.overview: This server runs multi-step research using any LLM. It performs web searches, analyzes the content it finds, and synthesizes everything into a report so you get a structured answer instead of a pile of links.
capabilities: Performs web searches and analyzes content
useCases: Students who need a researched, written-up answer rather than raw search results
Anyone running deeper research and wanting a synthesized report

Follow the README to install dependencies and configure an LLM
Register the MCP server with your AI client
Ask your assistant to research a topic and produce a report

example.label: Research prompt
example.code: Research the current state of solid-state batteries and write a short report with sources.

goodToKnow: It works with any LLM, so you choose which model powers the research.
Multi-step research can take longer and may use more tokens than a single query.

mcp_server/nutrient-document-web-service.tagline: Edit, sign, and process PDFs via API
mcp_server/nutrient-document-web-service.overview: This MCP server connects your AI client to Nutrient's document web services API. Through it you can edit PDFs, apply digital signatures, and run document-processing tasks without leaving your conversation.
capabilities: Connect to Nutrient's hosted document API
useCases: A student preparing signed assignment or form PDFs
Someone automating PDF edits inside an AI workflow

Ask your AI client to edit, sign, or process a PDF
Save the returned document

Built by pspdfkit; an API account/key is needed.

useCases: A student building a React project who wants animated UI fast

Add it to your MCP client config
Ask your AI client for a component from ReactBits
Install any flagged dependencies and drop the component in
goodToKnow: Components come from ReactBits.dev and are meant for React projects.
Dependency detection helps, but you still install the packages it flags.

mcp_server/chattempmail.overview: This server creates disposable temporary email addresses and reads incoming messages. It is useful for account verification and for keeping your real inbox private.
useCases: A student signing up for a service that needs email verification
Someone avoiding spam by using a throwaway address

Ask your AI client to create a temporary address
Read the verification message it receives
goodToKnow: Temporary inboxes are disposable, so don't use them for accounts you need long-term.
Good for verification, not for important mail.

mcp_server/smithsonian-open-access.overview: This server searches the Smithsonian Open Access API, letting you explore over three million museum objects, images, and their metadata. It is a window into the Smithsonian's open collections from your AI client.
capabilities: Search the Smithsonian Open Access API
Explore over three million museum objects
useCases: A student researching art, history, or science collections
Someone looking for openly licensed museum images

Add it to your MCP client config
Ask your AI client to search the collection
Review the objects, images, and metadata returned
goodToKnow: Covers Smithsonian Open Access content specifically.
Some content may require an API key from the Smithsonian.

mcp_server/jooq.overview: This server searches the jOOQ documentation and returns guides, code examples, and API references. jOOQ is a Java library for working with SQL, and this makes its docs easy to query.
useCases: A Java developer looking up jOOQ usage while coding
A student learning the jOOQ SQL library

Ask your AI client a jOOQ documentation question
Review the guides, examples, or API references returned

mcp_server/dall-e-3.overview: This server generates images using OpenAI's DALL-E 3. You can set the size, quality, and style of the images you create.

Uses DALL-E 3 specifically.

mcp_server/freightutils-mcp.tagline: Eleven freight and logistics tools for AI agents
mcp_server/freightutils-mcp.overview: This MCP server gives AI agents eleven freight logistics tools in one place. It covers things like ADR (dangerous goods) lookups, HS codes, airline codes, and shipping calculators so an agent can answer logistics questions directly.
capabilities: Provide eleven freight tools to an AI agent
useCases: A logistics or supply-chain student looking up HS codes and freight details for coursework
Anyone building an agent that needs to answer shipping and freight questions

Always confirm compliance details before relying on them for real shipments.

mcp_server/firecrawl.tagline: Scrape and crawl the web for AI
mcp_server/firecrawl.overview: Firecrawl is a web scraping and crawling API built for AI use. It handles JavaScript-heavy, dynamic pages and returns clean Markdown or structured JSON instead of messy HTML, so your agent can read the web reliably. It is open source and also offered as a hosted service with an API key.
capabilities: Scrapes single pages into clean Markdown or structured JSON
Crawls an entire site and returns content from every reachable page
Extracts structured data using a schema you define
Returns screenshots and other page outputs
useCases: Giving an AI agent live, readable web context for research
Building a RAG knowledge base from a documentation site
Monitoring or extracting structured data from many pages at scale

Add the Firecrawl MCP server to your client and set FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
Run via npx -y firecrawl-mcp in your MCP config
Ask your assistant to scrape a URL or crawl a site
Provide a JSON schema when you want structured extraction
goodToKnow: The hosted API is usage-priced; heavy crawling consumes credits, so test on small scopes first.
Respect target sites' terms of service and robots rules when scraping.

mcp_server/chrome-devtools.tagline: Test site speed and debug via Chrome DevTools
mcp_server/chrome-devtools.overview: Chrome DevTools MCP connects your AI assistant to Chrome through the DevTools protocol so it can test website speed, debug pages, and analyze performance in a live browser. capabilities: Opens and controls Chrome for live debugging
Inspects page elements and console output
Tracks network activity during a session
Helps confirm fixes in a real browser

Debugging a rendering or console error hands-on
Verifying that a front-end change behaves correctly

Add the chrome-devtools-mcp server to your MCP client
Run it with npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp
Ask the assistant to load a URL and profile it
Review the performance and network results it reports
goodToKnow: Requires Chrome installed locally since it drives a real browser.
Pin a version if you need reproducible behavior across machines.

mcp_server/interactive-terminal.tagline: Let your AI pause and ask you
mcp_server/interactive-terminal.overview: Interactive Terminal lets your AI assistant pause mid-task to ask you for input and send you notifications. It works across platforms so the assistant can check in before continuing.

Keep a human in the loop

Add it to your MCP client config
Ask your assistant to create or modify a pattern
Listen to the result in the browser
goodToKnow: Runs in the browser using Strudel for live coding.
Great for experimentation and learning music patterns.

mcp_server/dynatrace.tagline: Query your Dynatrace observability data with AI
mcp_server/dynatrace.overview: This server connects your AI assistant to the Dynatrace observability platform. It can query metrics, traces, security, and performance data so you can investigate how your applications are behaving through natural language.
